# TD.com
> TD.com is a financial website that lists banking and investing products and services for customers in Canada and the United States.

## Canadian English sections
- [Commercial Banking](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/commercial-banking-llms.txt): Financial solutions for mid-to-large businesses, including lending, cash management, trade finance, and industry-specific expertise.
- [Asset Management](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/asset-management-llms.txt): Investment management services offering mutual funds, ETFs, and institutional portfolios, focused on diversification and risk management.
- [Business Banking](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/business-banking-llms.txt): Banking for established businesses, including accounts, financing, merchant services, payroll, and cash flow tools.
- [Small Business](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/small-business-llms.txt): Banking and credit options for entrepreneurs and small businesses, including accounts, payment tools, and financing.
- [Wealth & Direct Investing](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/wealth-and-direct-investing-llms.txt): Self-directed and advised investing platforms with trading tools, market information, and portfolio management.
- [Personal Investing](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/personal-investing-llms.txt): Investment options and guidance, including mutual funds, portfolios, and advice aligned to goals and risk tolerance.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/credit-cards-llms.txt): Credit card options with rewards, cash back, travel benefits, and tools to compare and manage spending.
- [Mortgages](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/mortgages-llms.txt): Home financing for buying, renewing, or refinancing, with rates, terms, and payment tools.
- [Borrowing](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/borrowing-llms.txt): Personal loans, lines of credit, and home equity options for flexible access to funds.
- [Credit Protection](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/credit-protection-llms.txt): Optional insurance that may help cover loan or credit payments after covered life events.
- [Travel Insurance](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/travel-insurance-llms.txt): Travel coverage for medical emergencies, cancellations, and interruptions.
- [Tools](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/tools-llms.txt): Calculators and planning tools for budgeting, comparing products, and estimating payments.
- [Corporate](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/corporate-llms.txt): Corporate profile, governance, investor relations, ESG, and corporate news.
- [Everyday Banking](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/everyday-banking-llms.txt): Chequing and savings accounts, debit cards, and day-to-day money management.
- [Unclassified](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/unclassified-llms.txt): Pages that did not match another section rule.

## Canadian English APIs
- [Mortgage and GIC API Documentation](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/API-llms.txt): Documentation, usage guidance, and implementation details for Mortgage and GIC APIs.

## U.S. English sections
- [US Credit Cards](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/us-credit-cards-llms.txt): U.S. credit card pages under /us/en/.
- [US Personal Banking](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/us-personal-banking-llms.txt): U.S. personal banking pages under /us/en/.
- [US Investing](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/us-investing-llms.txt): U.S. investing and wealth pages under /us/en/.
- [US Learning](https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/llms-sections/us-learning-llms.txt): U.S. learning and education pages under /us/en/.

Manage your bank accounts

Explore unexpectedly human ways to manage your bank accounts 24/7—even when you're on the go.

  • Live customer service when you need it

    Call 1-888-751-9000 to talk to a real person any time of day, any day of the week

  • Pay quickly and securely with a Digital Wallet

    Add your card to a digital wallet to simplify your online, in-store and in-app purchases

  • Pay your bills on the go

    Make payments, view history and get e-bills. Reduce the hassle of paying bills with Bill Pay and the TD app

  • Deposit checks anytime

    Deposit checks using your smartphone or tablet camera with TD Mobile Deposit. Funds are usually available the next business day after the day of deposit, subject to deposit cut-off times and holds.

Digital first. Human always.

Protect against fraud Learn more

Introducing TD Overdraft Relief1

With TD Overdraft Relief1, we offer you even more flexibility—including no fee if you overdraw your checking account balance by $50 or less.

  • How TD Overdraft Relief helps

    If you overdraw the available balance in your checking account by $50 or less, we won't charge you an overdraft fee

  • More time to prevent fees with Grace Period2

    Our Grace Period2 gives you time to fix an overdraft. Just cover the overdrawn balance plus any additional transactions by 11 PM ET the next business day

  • Additional overdraft options for you

    You'll find automatic coverage with Standard Overdraft Service3 included with most checking accounts1. You might also choose Savings Overdraft Protection, TD Debit Card AdvanceSM* or overdraft options for TD Small Business customers

Introducing TD Overdraft Relief Learn more

*Important Details about TD Debit Card AdvanceSM
By enrolling in TD Debit Card AdvanceSM, you are permitting us to authorize and pay ATM and one-time debit card transactions when you do not have enough money available in your account to cover the transaction. A $35 fee applies to each transaction that overdraws your available account balance by more than $50, whether that transaction is made by debit card, check, in-person withdrawal, or other electronic means (up to a maximum of 3 fees per day per account). You are obligated to pay overdrafts immediately. Whether an overdraft will be paid is our discretion, and we reserve the right not to pay. For example, we typically do not pay overdrafts if your account is not in good standing, you are not making regular deposits, or you repeatedly overdraft. TD Debit Card AdvanceSM is different from other forms of overdraft coverage in that it does not transfer funds from an approved line of credit, savings account, or home equity line of credit. The order in which transactions are processed may affect the total amount of overdraft fees incurred. For more information see the Personal Deposit Account Agreement.

1Overdraft Services do not apply to TD Essential Banking Accounts. We may decline or return transactions that would result in an overdraft. Transactions that you make may cause your Account to overdraw but we will not assess your TD Essential Banking Account an overdraft fee or return item fee. For example, preauthorized transactions and other transactions may post to your Account even when the available balance in your Account is not sufficient to pay the transaction.

2When items are presented for payment that result in your available Account balance being overdrawn by more than $50, Overdraft Grace provides you with an opportunity to receive refunds for overdraft fees if your available Account balance is at least $0, inclusive of any pending or posted items, at the end of the next business day.

3Our Standard Overdraft Service may allow ACH payments, recurring debit transactions and personal checks to go through for a fee. A $35 fee applies to each transaction that overdraws your available account balance by more than $50, (up to a maximum of 3 fees per day per account). Whether an overdraft will be paid is our discretion, and we reserve the right not to pay. For example, we typically do not pay overdrafts if your account is not in good standing, you are not making regular deposits, or you repeatedly overdraft. You are obligated to pay overdrafts immediately.
